|translation='''Title:''' Wedge Antilles.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny even when otherwise unable to. You may spend 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one Corellian Slip and take it into hand. Then shuffle, cut, and replace the deck.

'''Lore:'''
A Corellian hero. He flies Red 2 at the Battle of Yavin. After losing his parents in an accident, he had enough inheritance to buy a freighter. He first sided with the Alliance as a weapons smuggler.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore calls him a Corellian hero.
